metaDescription: Kevin says Anthropic fought the US government over surveilling Americans, then questions its police reports as pre-crime like Minority Report.
summary: Kevin argues in this short that Anthropic got into a conflict with the American government because it said it would not surveil Americans. He asks what Anthropic's behavior is if not surveillance, referring to the company contacting police about users who it believes may attempt crimes. Kevin compares this to pre-crime from the film Minority Report.
